verdict_reason: The dashboard Commodity cell now shows a bare CN code that no AC or spec records, and the change leaves formatCommodity's name lookup with no caller.

todos.issue: The dashboard card's Commodity cell now shows a bare CN code (for example '0102') where it used to show a commodity name. toRow drops the commodityNameFor lookup. The stub list item carries { commodityCode }, and the real list item carries the backend commodity.name, which mapper-a now sets to lines[0].commodityCode, so formatCommodity falls back to the code. No AC in EUDPA-617 asks for this. REQ-DASH-003 says only 'its commodity', no spec or ins-tests change in the PR set records it, and the ticket's open question on commodity names (genus + spp. / description per the 15 Oct comments) is unresolved.
todos.fix: Must: the card's Commodity cell shows the value the design source sets for a commodity (for example the description or Latin name saved on the line), or showing the CN code is agreed and recorded in REQ-DASH-003 and the ticket. One way: carry the line's saved commodity description into the list item and render it, falling back to the code only when none is saved.

todos.issue: Dropping commodities.commodityNameFor here removes formatCommodity's only caller that passes nameForCode (notification-helper.js line 81). The parameter and its two lookup branches are now unreachable, and only notification-helper.test.js still exercises them. Build only what the change makes reachable.
todos.fix: Must: formatCommodity has no parameter or branch that no production caller reaches. One way: remove nameForCode from formatCommodity in notification-helper.js and drop its test case in the same change.

todos.issue: The comment on line 17 ('arrival is a day the user chose; created and submitted are moments.') explains the names formatDisplayCalendarDate and formatDisplayMoment, which already say it. A comment that decodes a name should be deleted.
todos.fix: Must: no comment above the arrival/created/submitted fields; the formatter names carry the distinction. One way: delete line 17.
